this_court: Adopts the statute-of-conviction approach to First Step Act § 404 eligibility and rejects the government's quantity-based approach; the opinion identifies no conflicting circuit holding.
quote: And sixth, the government's interpretation of § 404(a) is contrary to the clear weight of persuasive authority: no other court of appeals has adopted a quantity-based approach to § 404 eligibility.
cite: United States v. Anthony Jackson, 964 F.3d 197 (3rd Cir. 2020)
